name: Silent Hill 3 Enhanced Edition
author: matfsouza
description: Port of the PC version of Silent Hill 3 to the PS Vita, recompiled to run natively (no emulation). Locked 30 FPS, 960x544 in 16:9 with the 3D close to the PS2's 640x448, PS2 sound pitch restored, map and inventory in their PS2 4:3 frame, an on-screen cursor for the puzzles (left stick or D-pad) and safe saves.
requirements:
- Game data required: Your own copy of Silent Hill 3 for Windows (2003), prepared on a PC with sh3prep (see the GitHub README) and copied to ux0:data/sh3/. Only the sh3.exe with SHA-256 A51F956BD5BE21FD704C4D19CF0674A175D002081DA43B1D377BE83226C36E5E works.
- Plugin(s) required: libshacccg.suprx
